The PR inverts the headcount tiebreaker logic, contradicting the docstring. The code uses `-headcount` in the tiebreaker key, causing teams with smaller headcounts to win when quotients are tied. However, the docstring explicitly states: "the desk goes to the one with the larger headcount." The PR description even acknowledges this incorrectly, stating "The team with the smaller headcount wins."

While all tests pass, this is because no test case covers the scenario of different headcounts with identical quotients. The behavior contradicts the stated specification (docstring).

Fix: Change the tiebreaker from `(quotient, -headcount, -indices)` to `(quotient, headcount, -indices)` — remove the negation from headcount.
